message.content: {"draft":"Single-pass row mean. Use a smaller block (1024) to cut register pressure and improve occupancy for small/odd widths. Keep FP32 accumulation and divide by actual width.","plan":"1) Allocate contiguous output. 2) Launch one program per row. 3) Loop over width in 1024-wide masked chunks, accumulate in FP32. 4) Sum, divide by width, cast to input dtype, store scalar.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _row_mean_kernel(","    X,","    Y,","    stride,","    N,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","    IS_BF16: tl.constexpr,","):", "    row = tl.program_id(0)","    X += row * stride","    Y += row","    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_SIZE], dtype=tl.float32)","    for off in range(0, N, BLOCK_SIZE):","        cols = off + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","        mask = cols < N","        a = tl.load(X + cols, mask=mask, other=0.).to(tl.float32)","        acc += a","    total = tl.sum(acc, axis=0)","    mean = total / N","    if IS_BF16:","        val = mean.to(tl.bfloat16)","    else:","        val = mean.to(tl.float32)","    tl.store(Y, val)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()","    rows, width = x.shape","    out = torch.empty((rows,), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)","    if rows == 0 or width == 0:","        return out","    BLOCK_SIZE = 1024","    IS_BF16 = x.dtype == torch.bfloat16","    _row_mean_kernel[(rows,)](","        x, out, width, width, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE, IS_BF16=IS_BF16","    )","    return out"]}
